blocks.text: SAN ANTONIO — Stephon Castle had 26 points, Victor Wembanyama had 25 points and 16 rebounds, and the San Antonio Spurs surged in the second half for a 99-96 win over the Los Angeles Lakers on Friday night to advance to the NBA Cup knockout round. Castle was 10 for 15 from the field, including a 3-pointer that put San Antonio up 96-90 with 43.4 seconds remaining following De’Aaron Fox’s rebound of Wembanyama’s missed free throw.
